label: Drying cycles

public.setting: A laundry robot operates dryers for reusable fabric items.

approach.text: Move to the laundry dryer bay.

prepare.text: Position the load in the standard tumble dryer.
Position the load on the air-dry rack.

finish.text: Air-dry the load on the rack.

questions.text: How many completed dryer cycles are logged for this load?

Which laundry bay is this request assigned to?
What maximum temperature does the care label allow?
What is the load mass in kilograms?
